body:
(But still treat OS X as hard to support because I believe it is)

Probably won't work because of #8129

Changes:
* Python now gets compiled with clang too (which helps because the sanitizer instrumentation is the same)
* Fix for a build error to do with cpp_locals on clang
* We install `libomp-dev` for so we can use openmp
* We return the correct CFLAGS and LDFLAGS for clang to use with openmp
* environmental variables are set up to use the `libarcher` tool that provides OpenMP instrumentation on clang.
* We do skip some failing tests - I intend to fix those separately.
